gloss: in the blink of an eye; in an instant; in no time

definitions.gloss: in the blink of an eye; in an instant; in no time
definitions.explanation: Describes something happening extremely quickly, in the time it takes to blink. Often used to express surprise at how fast something occurred.

examples.japanese: {火|ひ}は{瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に{広|ひろ}がった。
examples.english: The fire spread in an instant.

examples.japanese: {新商品|しんしょうひん}は{瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に{売|う}り{切|き}れた。
examples.english: The new product sold out in no time.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちは{瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に{大|おお}きくなるので、{一日一日|いちにちいちにち}を{大切|たいせつ}にしたい。
examples.english: Children grow up in the blink of an eye, so I want to cherish each day.

notes:
Literally 'in the interval of blinking' ({瞬|またた}く to blink + {間|ま} interval + に). The image is that something happens so fast it occurs within a single blink of the eye.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に{広|ひろ}がる: to spread in an instant
- {瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に{過|す}ぎる: to pass in a flash
- {瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に{売|う}り{切|き}れる: to sell out instantly
- {瞬|またた}く{間|ま}に{消|き}える: to vanish in an instant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- あっという{間|ま}に: in no time, before you know it — more colloquial and conversational
- {一瞬|いっしゅん}で: in a moment — emphasizes a single instant
- たちまち: immediately, at once — similar speed but slightly more formal
- みるみる: visibly, rapidly — emphasizes that the change is observable in real time
